 Home Cryptocurrency Bitcoin extends losses as growth concerns increase amid stock market rout. What could change the trend? Bitcoin extends losses as growth concerns increase amid stock market rout. What could change the trend?
 Cryptocurrency Giuseppe Dellamotta 10 hours ago , published 20/11/2026 at 09:44 AM Tags bitcoin 
 Bitcoin Technical Analysis 
 Add as a preferred source on Google Summary
 Bitcoin remains under pressure as worsening growth concerns and negative risk sentiment weigh on the crypto market. The combination of Fed tightening, US-Iran tensions, limited fiscal stimulus and AI-related risks creates a bad macro backdrop. 
 Bitcoin extended
 the losses further yesterday following another rout in the stock market as growth
 concerns increased and the risk sentiment remained negative. 
 The market is
 seeing a slowdown in the economy in the next 6-12 months caused by Fed
 tightening, prolonged US-Iran stalemate, limited fiscal impulse due to the
 Democratic Congress and AI bubble burst. 
 This is a very
 negative macro backdrop that is likely to keep weighing on Bitcoin and the crypto
 market in general. Only a dovish Fed or a surprising breakthrough in the
 US-Iran situation are likely to reverse the current trend. 
 Next week, there’s
 only the US Flash PMIs as an important catalyst to watch. Weak data could
 exacerbate growth concerns and put further pressure on Bitcoin. Strong data, on
 the other hand, could trigger a short-term relief rally, although it wouldn’t
 change the bigger picture. 
 Of course, the
 focus will also be on US-Iran developments as an end to the war should lead to
 a positive repricing in growth expectations.
 BITCOIN TECHNICAL
 ANALYSIS – DAILY TIMEFRAME
 On the daily chart, we can
 see that Bitcoin broke below the support zone
 around the 62,400 level, opening the door for a move into the 58,000 support
 next. If the price gets there, we can expect the buyers to step in, with a
 defined risk below the support, to position for a rally into the major downward
 trendline around the 74,000 level. The sellers, on the other hand, will want to
 see the price breaking lower to increase the bearish bets into the 50,000 level
 next.
 BITCOIN TECHNICAL
 ANALYSIS – 4 HOUR TIMEFRAME
 On the 4 hour chart, we have
 a minor downward trendline defining the bearish momentum. If we get a pullback
 into the trendline, we can expect the sellers to lean on it, with a defined
 risk above it, to keep pushing into new lows. The buyers, on the other hand,
 will look for a break higher to increase the bullish bets into the major
 downward trendline next.
 BITCOIN TECHNICAL
 ANALYSIS – 1 HOUR TIMEFRAME
 On the 1 hour chart, we
 have another minor trendline that could act as resistance. The sellers will
 likely lean on the trendline, with a defined risk above it, to keep targeting
 the 58,000 support. The buyers, on the other hand, will look for a break higher
 to extend the pullback into the next trendline. The red lines define the average daily range for today.
 UPCOMING CATALYSTS
 Today we have Trump speaking
 at a press conference about his Asia trip, but he could certainly digress and
 talk about Iran. On Monday, we get the US Flash PMIs. On Thursday, we get the
 latest US Jobless Claims figures. The focus will remain on growth concerns, the
 Fed and US-Iran developments.
